subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A large number of fish swimming together.
solution:
The correct answer is **'shoal'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look into the meaning of the words in the options - 
 
 
• **Gaggle - **a flock of geese.
 
• **Herd - **a large group of animals, especially hoofed mammals, that live together or are kept together as livestock.
 
• **Pride - **a group of lions forming a social unit.
 
• **Shoal - **a large number of fish swimming together as a group.
 
 
 
• From the** above meanings** it is clear that **shoal **is the best word to substitute the given group of words. 
 
• Hence, **option 4 **is the correct answer.
